messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Live-cut to weightset 'w-2026-03-17-rc2' (canary=5%) — elevated tokenization errors (≈12% of requests), tail latencies rising. Logs: https://ci.redwood/logs/xyz 

mike_oncall: ack, I'm on it. moving to triage — paging on-call.

sam_ml: looks like tokenizer mismatch between bundle and runtime. seeing lots of `vocab_lookup` misses during decode. example log:
```
ERROR decode: tokenizer.vocab_lookup: id 50213 not in vocab (len=50212)
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File \"/srv/decoder/worker.py\", line 412, in decode
    tok = vocab[id]
KeyError: 50213
```

anya_prod: can we flip the live-cut flag to stop using rc2 for canary? need quick mitigation for customers.

jen_sre: I can flip the kill-switch. flag is `feature.model_live_use_rc_weights`. Recommend disabling for canary immediately.

liam_csm: FYI @mike_oncall we have one customer (AcmeCorp) reporting garbled tokens in chat — support has the transcript. No major SLA yet but visible.

mike_oncall: plan: (1) flip feature flag for canary now (2) if that stabilizes, rollback artifact for canary and hold prod rollout (3) smoke tests then pickup postmortem. Sam — did you trigger the cut?

sam_ml: yeah that was my rollout. root cause preliminary: build pipeline bundled tokenizer v1.0 but weights compiled expecting tokenizer v1.1 (vocab length mismatch). I'll stop further promotions.

jen_sre: flipping flag for canary -> false now... :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Feature flag change recorded: `feature.model_live_use_rc_weights=false` (scope: canary). change-id=fchg-202603-01.

jen_sre: monitoring: canary error rate dropping — down from 12% -> 0.9% in 90s. Latency tail back to baseline.

mike_oncall: good. Sam, please run rollback to stable weightset in canary and avoid prod promotion. Provide command if you need help.

sam_ml: starting rollback to `w-stable-202603` now. command:
```
./release/promote.sh --from w-stable-202603 --to canary --force --skip-smoke=false
```
Promotion job queued (job id: promo-xyz123).

deploy-bot: Promotion job promo-xyz123 started. ETA ~2m.

deploy-bot: Promotion job promo-xyz123 completed successfully. Canary now serving `w-stable-202603`.

jen_sre: running smoke tests against canary endpoints — all good. tokenizer errors gone.

liam_csm: letting AcmeCorp know we rolled back canary and are investigating root cause. I'll update them that outputs should look normal now and ask for a confirmation.

mike_oncall: marking incident as mitigated for now. severity: Sev3 (customer visible but contained). Next immediate action items:
- sam_ml: root cause postmortem + fix build to pin tokenizer artifact
- eng-infra: add pre-cut smoke that validates vocab size vs expected (add to runbook)
- devex: add automated check in release pipeline to fail if tokenizer-vocab mismatch

anya_prod: assigning postmortem owner to @sam_ml.

sam_ml: I will own the postmortem and start the draft. Will include repro, buildfix, and a test to validate vocab length.

jen_sre: handing off followups to daytime oncall @jen_sre for tomorrow. I'll keep watch for any regression.

mike_oncall: thanks everyone. I'll close the page but please update the incident doc with timestamps and notes.

liam_csm: I'll confirm with AcmeCorp once they validate outputs.

sam_ml: notes: avoid re-running full live-cut until build fixes are merged.

mike_oncall: end of thread — incident mitigated, postmortem assigned.
